findings.problem: It says a candidate is for work with “a finish line of its own,” but item 2 requires a candidate to join an existing roadmap precisely when it shares that roadmap’s finish line. This makes the central placement rule internally contradictory.
findings.suggestion: Say that a candidate is bounded new work that advances a roadmap’s finish line; reserve `Candidate: none` for corrections or fixes too small to warrant roadmap direction.

findings.problem: The provenance says there was “no tool version to record,” despite recording results from `grep` and `wc`. The decisions README requires evidence to state tool versions.
findings.suggestion: Record the relevant command/tool versions, or state explicitly why version information is unavailable and remove the claim that no version needs recording.

summary: The candidate-placement rule needs clarification because its two decision clauses conflict. Evidence provenance also omits required tool-version information.
